dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: Yo, listen up. I got a job for ya if you're interested.

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: What's the deal?

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: I need someone to retrieve an old cyberware chip from a client who won't pay up. It's valuable, and I ain't got time for this.

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: And what makes you think I'm the one for the job?

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: Heard you're good at what you do. Plus, I know you could use the creds. So, you in?

quest: Retrieve a stolen prototype cyberdeck from a rival gang.

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: Hey there, I know you're new in Night City. But I've heard good things about you.

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: Thanks. What do you need?

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: I'm in a bit of trouble. My old squad's prototype cyberdeck was stolen by a rival gang.

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: And you want me to retrieve it?

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: Exactly. You'll need to infiltrate their hideout and take out their leader, Vexx.

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: Ah, amigo! You look like you're in need of some... special equipment. I've got just the thing for you.

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: I've got a rusty old cyberdeck, but it's got potential. Needs some tweaking, though. You're the tech-savvy type, right?

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: What's your angle, Diego?

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: I need info from a corporate net, and this deck is my key. I'll pay you well if you can get it working. Deal?

quest: Retrieve stolen military grade cyberware from a rival gang.

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: Yo, listen up. I got a job for ya. Some lowlifes jacked some hot military tech from my old unit.

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: What's in it for me?

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: I'll cut you in on the sell, and we can split the cash 50/50. Plus, I know a doc who'll fix ya up if you need.

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: Alright, let's do this.

quest: Need someone to retrieve a rare cyberdeck from a corporate facility.

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: Ah, you look like a capable type. I've got a job for ya.

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: What's it about?

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: I need a rare cyberdeck retrieved from a corp facility. It's too hot for me to handle right now.

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: Why me?

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: You're new here, no history. Less likely to be recognized. Plus, you've got that 'look' about ya.
